Confidence That Never Dims

The CG3200X is the first OLED model in the ColorEdge family, bringing decades of color management expertise to a new generation of display technology. It delivers ColorEdge-class precision for workflows mastered in HLG, PQ, or SDR, ensuring reliable results across every stage of production. Powered by a Quantum Dot OLED panel, it offers exceptional HDR control, vivid color expression, and deep blacks that add true depth to every image. The generous 31.5-inch screen keeps timelines and tools comfortably in view, while 4K UHD resolution (3840 x 2160) renders content with striking clarity.

EIZO's Proprietary ABL Control System

Higher Luminance Thresholds

Conventional OLED monitors rely on ABL (Automatic Brightness Limiter) to protect the panel during bright scenes. As more of the screen becomes luminous, ABL automatically reduces overall brightness, often causing visible shifts that can alter tonal balance and color perception. The CG3200X is engineered with higher luminance thresholds to reduce unnecessary dimming, preserving brightness across more of the image compared to conventional ABL, where bright scenes can trigger aggressive dimming.



Article: How EIZO Reduced Unnecessary Dimming in Professional OLED Workflows
 

Flexible Dimming Modes

Even when ABL engages, editors can optimize luminance handling with a choice of two dimming modes, allowing flexibility to suit different project requirements.

Highlight Dimming
Reduces brightness only in the most luminous areas, preserving detail and tonal integrity in mid- and low-luminance regions.

Uniform Dimming
Adjusts brightness evenly across the entire screen, stabilizing the balance between highlights and shadows while maintainig overall tonal integrity for consistent image evaluation.

Image for illustrative purposes

 

Instant Feedback with Status Indicator

A blue status indicator lights up whenever ABL control is active, giving creators clear insight into the monitor’s operating state without disrupting the workflow.

Luminance Warning

The Luminance Warning function uses color indicators to identify areas that clip at a defined brightness level. In Highlight Dimming mode, it also highlights regions affected by ABL, making both easy to identify. The indicator color can be set to yellow or magenta.


 

Maintain Creative Intent

ABL can affect accurate highlight evaluation if a bright scene causes unexpected dimming. ABL Safe View helps prevent this by reducing the display area to 10% or 25%, lowering the average brightness and reducing the likelihood of ABL activation. This allows creators to preview content at its intended brightness without automatic dimming.


 

Editing and Mastering

True HDR

The CG3200X features a QD-OLED panel that delivers 1000 cd/m² peak luminance and 300 cd/m² full-screen white, combined with an exceptional 1,500,000:1 contrast ratio. This enables precise reproduction from intense highlights to deep blacks, providing the rich expressive range for HDR content.

The monitor supports the hybrid log-gamma (HLG) transfer function for broadcasting and the perceptual quantization (PQ) curve for the production of films and streamed content.

Learn more about HDR technology

Image for illustrative purposes only.

 

Custom Contrast

Since SDR content is typically created for display devices with contrast ratios in the range of 1000:1 to 2000:1, it can appear differently on OLED monitors with significantly higher contrast capabilities. The CG3200X allows users to set a custom contrast ratio from 500:1 to 2000:1 in 100-step increments, enabling a more accurate and controlled working representation of SDR content and supporting consistent results across viewing environments.
 

Color Fringe Reduction

With conventional OLED monitors, high-contrast edges in text and fine details can exhibit color fringing. The CG3200X has a dedicated circuit that reduces these artifacts, producing cleaner edges.

Japan patent no. 7846316


 

Faithful Motion for Cinematic Content

The monitor supports 24 Hz and 48 Hz for native display of cinematic content produced at 24 fps. This ensures accurate motion reproduction and artifact-free playback, supporting precise creative decisions in motion, pacing, and shot continuity. As a result, motion can be evaluated exactly as it will appear in final theatrical or streaming delivery.
 

Clear Viewing

The AGLR (Anti-Glare, Low-Reflection) screen reduces glare and ambient reflections, ensuring clear and comfortable viewing.

 

Simple and Precise Color Management

Built-In Sensor to Automate Your Workflow

The monitor features EIZO's built-in calibration sensor to maintain color accuracy. This eliminates the need for a third-party calibration device and streamlines color management so editors can stay focused on the creative process. The sensor design has been enhanced, delivering quieter operation for a more focused working environment.

 

Color Management Software

A monitor needs to be calibrated at regular intervals to maintain color accuracy. EIZO's proprietary color management software provides an intuitive and highly precise solution to color management. It allows you to schedule automatic recalibration, calibrate all color modes simultaneously, and conduct correlation with high-end spectrophotometers to match the studio's internal color management framework.

 

 

Additionally, EIZO's ColorNavigator API is available for software developers and system managers to integrate ColorNavigator 7 or ColorNavigator Network functions into third-party applications, such as those used for video editing, color grading, proofing systems, digital graphics, and even remote control. This allows developers to use the API to improve operations throughout the workflow.

ColorNavigator API developer reference page
 

Signal Processing

Sync Signal

The monitor’s Sync Signal function automatically switches color settings, including brightness, gamma (EOTF), and color gamut, according to the metadata of the input signal. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments when working across multiple projects, ensuring users are always working with the correct settings. For added flexibility, users can assign specific color modes to different signal types, enabling customized automatic switching to preset color modes.

Nearest Neighbor Interpolation

The monitor supports the Nearest Neighbor image scaling method, which enlarges images by directly copying and replicating the original pixels closest to each target pixel position. Because this method avoids color blending, it preserves the original pixel values, ensuring accurate color reproduction. When Nearest Neighbor is turned off, interpolation is performed using surrounding pixels, resulting in smoother gradations. Editors can easily select the method best suited to their project via the monitor’s OSD menu.

 

Color You Can Trust

Wide Color Gamut

The monitor's wide color gamut covers 99% of the DCI-P3 standard used in digital cinema and supports the BT.2020 standard used in broadcasting for exceptionally faithful reproduction of color. It also covers 94% of the Adobe RGB color space so images and video shot in Adobe RGB will be displayed correctly. Color mode presets can easily be changed via the switches on the front of the monitor, enabling straightforward color management for each project.

 

10-Bit Simultaneous Display

The CG3200X delivers 10-bit simultaneous display* from a 24-bit look-up table (LUT), enabling the reproduction of over one billion colors simultaneously. This provides 64 times more color detail than an 8-bit display, resulting in smoother gradations and reduced Delta-E between adjacent colors.

Each ColorEdge monitor undergoes factory gamma adjustment by measuring RGB values across 0–1023 levels. A 16-bit LUT is then applied to ensure optimal tonal accuracy and smooth color transitions. Every CG3200X includes a Factory Report documenting production measurements, including uniformity, gamma, gamut coverage, and color temperature, verifying the precision of each unit.

Learn more about the Factory Report

*A graphics board and software which support 10-bit output are also necessary for 10-bit display. Equipment that supports DeepColor is required for 10-bit display when connected via HDMI®.

 

Uniformity Across the Screen

Monitors commonly exhibit fluctuations in brightness and chromaticity across the screen, affecting color accuracy. To counter this, ColorEdge monitors are equipped with EIZO's patented digital uniformity equalizer (DUE)* technology which corrects deviations in every tone across the screen to ensure stable display.

*Japan patent no. 4490899, 4542988, 5618574, 5651419

 

Pixel Inspection

Working within the wrong parameters affects editing decisions, potentially requiring significant rework of projects and causing costly delays in production schedules. Pixel Inspection, operated through the monitor's OSD, shows the color information of a pixel from the source input data and the data as it is displayed on the monitor.

System managers can use this information to verify that the creator's technical settings match the current project's predefined color parameters, reducing the likelihood of project rework due to mismatched technical settings.

 

Designed for Comfort and Productivity

Immersive Frameless Design and Shading Hood

The new 2-sided frameless design minimizes borders so your content stays in focus, while the slim upper bezel discreetly houses the built-in calibration sensor. The included magnetic shading hood reduces glare, attaching and detaching easily without complicated assembly. Together, they create a clean, focused workspace that supports accurate and comfortable viewing.



 

Single Cable Connection with USB Type-C®

With USB Type-C, a single cable transmits video signal, USB data, and up to 60 W of power delivery so you can connect, charge, and create without juggling cords or adapters. This is especially helpful for creators who move between setups or work on laptops in mobile or hybrid environments.

The monitor is also equipped with DisplayPortTM and HDMI inputs. 2 USB Type-A ports are available for connecting peripherals.

Audio Jack

An easy-access headphone jack lets you connect headphones directly for convenient audio monitoring during content creation. 

 

Control Multiple PCs with One Keyboard and Mouse

The built-in KVM switch function enables a single USB mouse and keyboard to be shared across multiple connected PCs. Connect the peripherals to the monitor’s USB hub and seamlessly switch control between PCs using the monitor’s front buttons.

OLED Protection

Maintain Panel Performance and Longevity

The monitor incorporates multiple built-in functions to help reduce the risk of image retention and maintain stable panel performance over time.

A screen saver automatically lowers brightness when the image remains unchanged, reducing stress on static pixels. Pixel Shift (wobbling) subtly moves the image position to prevent prolonged use of the same pixels, while Pixel Cleaning (Off Sensing) compensates for panel degradation to sustain image uniformity over time.

To further protect the panel, Thermal Modulation reduces brightness when internal temperatures rise, preventing extended high-temperature operation. Together, these technologies work seamlessly in the background to preserve image quality and extend the lifespan of the OLED panel.
 

Sustainable Future

Low Environmental Impact Materials

A portion of the plastic used in the monitor is recycled plastic. This contributes to reducing the amount of plastic waste entering the environment, conserves resources, and promotes the reuse of materials to preserve our natural ecosystems.

Eco-Conscious Packaging

EIZO is committed to reducing its environmental impact by transitioning away from plastic and other environmentally unfriendly materials in product packaging. The CG3200X is securely packaged using molded pulp made from recycled cardboard and newspaper, and its cables are wrapped in paper instead of plastic bags.

 

Commitment to Quality

5-Year Warranty

The monitor is backed by a 5-year manufacturer's warranty for long-term reliability. EIZO can guarantee the long service life because it manufactures its products at its own factories, ensuring close control over production quality.

Usage time limited to 30,000 hours. OLED panel warranted for 1 year and usage time limited to 10,000 hours.
Image retention or burn-in resulting from prolonged display of high-brightness content or static images is not covered under warranty.

Zero Bright Pixels

EIZO guarantees this product will be free from bright sub-pixels for six months from the purchase date.

See our Bright Pixel Policy for more details


Our Contribution to SDGs

As part of its sustainability initiatives, EIZO is contributing towards the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).  

Environmentally Conscious Product Development
ColorEdge promotes the use of recycled materials and low-impact components, while maintaining the high performance demanded for creative work. The monitors are optimized for energy efficiency, contributing to lower greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.

EIZO also collects and recycles used products to further minimize environmental impact. We strive to promote efficient and circular resource use across every stage of the product lifecycle - from parts and materials procurement to manufacturing, transportation, user experience, and end-of-life disposal.

All production sites at EIZO’s headquarters in Japan operate on 100% renewable energy.

Color Precision for Creative Excellence
ColorEdge provides a high-precision color management solution for creative environments, powered by advanced display technology and consistent color control. Unified color management across the entire production workflow streamlines color communication across creative teams and studios, helping to reduce time and costs associated with rework due to color inconsistencies.
